title: Basic Sous Vide Chicken Breast
description: Chicken that doesn't taste like rubber

info.servings: Cooks for 1 but can be scaled up however much you want and makes good leftovers

items.text: 4 slices of lemon (2 per chicken breast)

steps.text: Season both sides of chicken breasts with salt and pepper and some olive oil
Sear for 1-2 minutes per side on a hot cast iron (with olive oil) when done

notes: Don't seal with the lemons direclty on the chicken otherwise it will indent into the chicken and make it look weird
You'll want to cut the chicken breasts in half lengthwise unless you get thinly slice chicken breasts in which case cook for the minimum time
If using frozen chicken breasts add 1/2 the time to the original (per Chef Steps) so 1.5 hours becomes 2.25 hours
